LanguageData.VFEI2_RoyalMegascarab.description: A medium-sized naturally-evolved insectoid the size of a sheep. Being part of the royal hive, these larger megascarabs act as a worker caste of the primary hives, and are always seen serving around the hive leaders. Its size and hard shell make it dangerous when it attacks. Unlike their bioengineered cousins, these insectoids have been created by the hive leaders to protect the most important hives, and their genetic composition and evolution path are a mystery to scientists.
